description: ADR 0018 (BFF): in canonical control mode an AC turn is canonical or an explicit error. A turn whose canonical state could not be prepared gets an explicit error (degraded reason) and is not sent to the orchestrator; a reply whose canonical result degraded or could not be recorded is not shown as a normal answer; SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE carries the degraded reason; an invalid or expired token starts a fresh canonical session (reported as stateReset).
